entries.title: II Kings 24:1
segments: ¶In his days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up, and Jehoiakim became his vassal [for] three years. Then he turned and rebelled against him.

entries.title: II Kings 24:2
segments: And the LORD sent against him [raiding] bands of Chaldeans, bands of Syrians, bands of Moabites, and bands of the people of Ammon; He sent them against Judah to destroy it, according to the word of the LORD which He had spoken by His servants the prophets.

entries.title: II Kings 24:3
segments: Surely at the commandment of the LORD [this] came upon Judah, to remove [them] from His sight because of the sins of Manasseh, according to all that he had done,

entries.title: II Kings 24:4
segments: and also because of the innocent blood that he had shed; for he had filled Jerusalem with innocent blood, which the LORD would not pardon.

entries.title: II Kings 24:5
segments: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and all that he did, [are] they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

entries.title: II Kings 24:6
segments: So Jehoiakim rested with his fathers. Then Jehoiachin his son reigned in his place.

entries.title: II Kings 24:7
segments: And the king of Egypt did not come out of his land anymore, for the king of Babylon had taken all that belonged to the king of Egypt from the Brook of Egypt to the River Euphrates.

entries.title: II Kings 24:8
segments: ¶Jehoiachin [was] eighteen years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. His mother's name [was] Nehushta the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem.

entries.title: II Kings 24:9
segments: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his father had done.

entries.title: II Kings 24:10
segments: At that time the servants of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against Jerusalem, and the city was besieged.

entries.title: II Kings 24:11
segments: And Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came against the city, as his servants were besieging it.

entries.title: II Kings 24:12
segments: Then Jehoiachin king of Judah, his mother, his servants, his princes, and his officers went out to the king of Babylon; and the king of Babylon, in the eighth year of his reign, took him prisoner.

entries.title: II Kings 24:13
segments: And he carried out from there all the treasures of the house of the LORD and the treasures of the king's house, and he cut in pieces all the articles of gold which Solomon king of Israel had made in the temple of the LORD, as the LORD had said.

entries.title: II Kings 24:14
segments: Also he carried into captivity all Jerusalem: all the captains and all the mighty men of valor, ten thousand captives, and all the craftsmen and smiths. None remained except the poorest people of the land.

entries.title: II Kings 24:15
segments: And he carried Jehoiachin captive to Babylon. The king's mother, the king's wives, his officers, and the mighty of the land he carried into captivity from Jerusalem to Babylon.

entries.title: II Kings 24:16
segments: All the valiant men, seven thousand, and craftsmen and smiths, one thousand, all [who were] strong [and] fit for war, these the king of Babylon brought captive to Babylon.

entries.title: II Kings 24:17
segments: Then the king of Babylon made Mattaniah, [Jehoiachin's] uncle, king in his place, and changed his name to Zedekiah.

entries.title: II Kings 24:18
segments: Zedekiah [was] twenty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. His mother's name [was] Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

entries.title: II Kings 24:19
segments: He also did evil in the sight of the LORD, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.

entries.title: II Kings 24:20
segments: For because of the anger of the LORD [this] happened in Jerusalem and Judah, that He finally cast them out from His presence. Then Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.
